push:
Spurs @ Blazers 8/10 9:00 - Wemby, Fox questionable, should be close
Wolves @ Thunder 7/10 6:30 - Two banged-up contenders, coin flip
Heat @ 76ers 6/10 4:00 - Giannis versus Maxey, no Embiid

games.notes: Wembanyama (back) and Fox (shin) questionable, Harper and Harris out. Portland is missing Morant and Sharpe, so this should be close and fun if Wemby plays.
Edwards out for Minnesota; Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Wallace and Topic out for OKC. Two contenders short-handed, so SGA's night decides it. Should be close.
Embiid out (illness) for Philly; Giannis is available for Miami. Maxey carries the Sixers against a Heat team on a seven-game win streak. Should be close.
Brunson questionable, Anunoby and McBride out for the champs; Mobley out for Cleveland. Knicks should win, but a mid Cavs team is a so-so watch.
Boozer, GG Jackson, Grant and Pippen out for Memphis; Beal out for LA. Good record, banged-up roster against a bad Clippers team. Likely a Memphis win, skippable.
Mark Williams out for Phoenix. Durant and the healthy Rockets should handle a Suns team that is just okay, likely blowout.
Curry and Butler out for Golden State; LaVine questionable for Sacramento. The reason to watch is gone, and the Kings are 2-15. Skip.
Knueppel, Schroder, Allen and Kalkbrenner out for Charlotte; Powell and Caleb Wilson out for Chicago. Two bad, depleted teams.
Two of the worst teams in the league, with the Bucks at 2-16. Nothing to see here.
